description: This file defines a PHP class named EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams, which extends a base class FilterParams. It models search filter parameters specifically for employee salary data within the OrangeHRM system, including allowed sort fields and an employee number attribute.

classes.name: EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates filter parameters for searching employee salary records, including sort options and employee identifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'es.salaryName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion. It can be null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion. It accepts an integer or null.
